# Aswapathy Raj — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Aswapathy Raj, a full-stack developer building modern web
> applications from interface to database and deployment. The site itself is
> built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, and documents four projects with
> full case studies, architecture diagrams, database schemas, and an
> in-browser mock API explorer.

## Site

- [Portfolio homepage](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/): overview, stack, projects, and contact
- [QR Food Ordering System case study](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/projects/qr-food-ordering): full-stack restaurant ordering, no accounts — identity derived from the table's QR token
- [Developer Portfolio case study](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/projects/developer-portfolio): the site you are reading
- [CameraPort case study](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/projects/cameraport): camera repair service management platform (Python/Flask)
- [Are You A Girl? case study](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/projects/are-you-a-girl): interactive quiz web experience
- [Resume (PDF)](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/resume.pdf)

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/aswapathyraj): public repositories (JavaScript/Python)
- [Site sitemap](https://portfolio-v2-weld-five.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
- Contact: aswapathyraj@gmail.com

## Notes for agents

- The `/api/public/*` endpoints described by the on-site API explorer are
  mocked in the browser and are not reachable over the network; treat them as
  documentation, not as live services.
- The portfolio source code is published at
  https://github.com/aswapathyraj/portfolio-V2.
